analogy.rationale: Oxidative stress inducers activate NRF2/NF-kB stress programs and HSP responses, so antioxidants and NF-kB/HSP inhibitors should yield the most similar transcriptional signatures; PPAR and lipoxygenase classes share lipid/redox-related downstream programs but overlap less.
